{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I'll have you know I'm working in one of my favorite hang-outs, The Binary Bar on Vanaari. I find that the atmosphere gets the creative juices flowing.|[[Cohden K'Reye]]|<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>}}
The '''Binary Bar''' was a tavern located in the [[Ven-Kav]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venaari]]. One of the bar's most popular drinks was the [[Angerian Fishak Surprise]].<ref name="WHSV" />

[[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Cohden K'Reye]] was a regular at the bar, and it was one of his favorite hang-outs for inspiring creativity. On one occasion, K'Reye was accosted by a surly [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] while creating a tour guide to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], and paused to take care of the trouble-maker before resuming his work.<ref name="WHSV" />
